user.title: Visio
user.description: Add the Visio dashboard panel to the sidebar. Cameras are discovered automatically and configured from the panel's Settings view.

move_blinds.name: Move blinds
move_blinds.description: Move blinds one at a time (some hubs drop simultaneous commands). After about 75 s, Visio checks each blind and sends the command once more to any that didn't move.

entity_id.name: Blinds
entity_id.description: The blinds to move, in this order.
